dialogues.speaker: Wuwang
dialogues.text: Thank goodness you're here. I think I'm lost...

dialogues.speaker: Wuwang
dialogues.text: And I think I must have eaten something a bit suspect, I'm feeling a little rough...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you okay?

dialogues.speaker: Wuwang
dialogues.text: I'm looking for someone. The woman I love.

dialogues.speaker: Wuwang
dialogues.text: We met at... I forget, but it was either a theater or a tea house. Anyway, I was an adventurer, darting off all over the place, and she was a performer there...

dialogues.speaker: Wuwang
dialogues.text: You'd definitely have heard of her if you'd been there. Everyone's been singing her praises these past few years.

dialogues.speaker: Wuwang
dialogues.text: We hit it off straight away, and both of us felt we were ready to pack in the drudgery of normal life. So we promised we'd move out to the country together...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who is she?

dialogues.speaker: Wuwang
dialogues.text: Her name is...

dialogues.speaker: Wuwang
dialogues.text: ...Huh, that's strange. I seem to have forgotten her name.

dialogues.speaker: Wuwang
dialogues.text: I'm so scatter brained these days. Bits and pieces of memories, all jumbled together...

dialogues.speaker: Wuwang
dialogues.text: As I recall, my buddy and I agreed to go on one last big seafaring adventure before I made the move. And then something happened...

dialogues.speaker: Wuwang
dialogues.text: I don't know what. And I can't remember her name. All I remember is the promises we made... to live a simple life together, to watch the sunrise and sunset together, to grow old together...

dialogues.speaker: Wuwang
dialogues.text: Where should I go? Why can't I remember her name...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Feeling rough in what way?

dialogues.speaker: Wuwang
dialogues.text: It's hard to describe... It's like I feel dizzy all the time, and I'm so drowsy during the day that I have to try to force myself to stay awake, but I just can't do it...

dialogues.speaker: Wuwang
dialogues.text: And then when I finally come round, it's dark out. So I have to travel during the night to catch up.

dialogues.speaker: Wuwang
dialogues.text: But at nighttime there's never anyone around to ask for directions. I once saw a guy sleeping by the side of the road and tried to wake him up...

dialogues.speaker: Wuwang
dialogues.text: But it was like he couldn't hear a word I was saying. And I tried to shake him awake, but I somehow couldn't touch him, either... Do you think he was a ghost?

dialogues.speaker: Wuwang
dialogues.text: ...Ugh, never mind all that, I should get going.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Wuwang
dialogues.text: I will find her, I know I will. However long it takes, wherever she is...
